answer: Fee-audited passage: each identity pays a small toll in POA for every unique request path it serves, and a customs ledger records each payment against one fingerprint only. The trigger is a reuse check at the narrow inlet of the ledger: when two identities show the same payment history, both accounts freeze until a hearing. Every forged persona must therefore fund its own full toll stream, costing roughly 500 POA per identity, while honest operators pass through once and their deposit returns after a clean prism audit at the quarterly summit.
